title: Khiamniungan language - Wikipedia
text: Khiamniungan, also known as Khiamniungan Naga, is a Sino-Tibetan language spoken by the Khiamniungan people in Noklak district of Nagaland, easternmost part of India.

title: Naga, Khiamniungan | Ethnologue Free
text: Khiamniungan Naga is a stable indigenous language of India and Myanmar. It belongs to the Sino-Tibetan language family.
